bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for capital improvements for Lutheran Social Service in the city of St. Paul.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+LUTHERAN SOCIAL SERVICE; ST. PAUL. +]

[+$2,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Lutheran Social Service of Minnesota to design, construct, renovate, and equip capital improvements to an existing service site at 709 University Avenue West in the city of St. Paul. This appropriation includes money for accessibility and modernization capital improvements, preservation and expansion of site-based transitional housing units for youth and parenting youth experiencing housing instability, expansion of a therapeutic preschool, and improvements to office space for employment services, financial counseling, housing services, and behavioral health services. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for capital improvements for Lutheran Social Service in the city of St. Paul.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. LUTHERAN SOCIAL SERVICE; ST. PAUL.

$2,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Lutheran Social Service of Minnesota to design, construct, renovate, and equip capital improvements to an existing service site at 709 University Avenue West in the city of St. Paul. This appropriation includes money for accessibility and modernization capital improvements, preservation and expansion of site-based transitional housing units for youth and parenting youth experiencing housing instability, expansion of a therapeutic preschool, and improvements to office space for employment services, financial counseling, housing services, and behavioral health services. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.

This appropriation includes money for accessibility and modernization capital improvements, preservation and expansion of site-based transitional housing units for youth and parenting youth experiencing housing instability, expansion of a therapeutic preschool, and improvements to office space for employment services, financial counseling, housing services, and behavioral health services. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.
